articles.title: Amplitude Therapeutics and Lilly Enter Strategic Collaboration to Develop Trans-Amplifying RNA Vaccines for Infectious Diseases
articles.summary: Amplitude Therapeutics, a biotechnology company developing trans-amplifying RNA (taRNA) medicines and vaccines, today announced a strategic research collaboration and licensing agreement with Eli Lilly and Company ("Lilly") to discover and develop taRNA vaccine candidates for infectious diseases.
